registration_note: Registered 2026-09-30, before any of these watches had a scored forward day (all PRE_START at 2026-09-29 21:15Z). Makes each 180-day review mechanical: the evaluator reads the frozen watch report and returns a verdict from the criteria below; nothing is chosen at review time. Trend-core criteria are copied verbatim from each watch's own review_criteria_at_180_days; the multi-premia criteria are new and follow the same sanity-gate form.

verdicts.PASS_SANITY_GATE: every criterion met; eligible to be submitted to the existing paper/approval gates, which this file does not authorize
verdicts.INCOMPLETE: a criterion could not be evaluated from the frozen artifacts; no verdict until it can be
verdicts.NOT_YET: the review horizon has not been reached

reviews.threshold_rationale: drawdown guardrail about 1.4x the worst drawdown seen in development (-14%) and the untouched holdout (-11%)
secondary book; guardrail about 1.1x the development drawdown (-31%); the untouched holdout already failed this book (Sharpe 0.60), so a pass here is weak evidence

funding.rule: pass if realized >= 0 (funding received) or |realized| <= 2 x |estimate|

funding.realized: crypto-trend-core-v1 report funding_contribution.combined.annualized x this report's overlay_state.forward_mean_leverage (this watch reports no funding split; it is the core book scaled by the overlay)
funding.rule: pass if realized >= 0 or |realized| <= 2 x |estimate| x forward_mean_leverage

note: 180 days cannot establish an edge (minimum detectable Sharpe about 2.8). A PASS only means nothing has gone wrong; it is not out-of-sample proof.

amendments.change: added the funding estimate and realized-funding source for the two trend-core reviews; the watch reports carry no estimate of their own
